summary: docs(agents): record the engineering-skill config (issue tracker, triage labels, domain docs)
reason: The Matt Pocock engineering skills (to-tickets, triage, to-spec, wayfinder, domain-modeling) read per-repo configuration from docs/agents/*.md and are pointed there by an '## Agent skills' section in AGENTS.md. Without it those skills have no idea that issues live in GitHub Issues for nytafar/fiken-cli, which label strings to apply, or where domain docs sit. The section is additive and sits after the generated content.
validated_outcome: Documentation only; no code paths touched. Verified the three docs/agents files exist and that AGENTS.md carries exactly one '## Agent skills' section.
